en: This Desktop alpha adds the macOS launch path and Windows installer support needed for an upgrade from 1.6.2-alpha.2. The old update feed requires separate native acceptance before it can offer the upgrade. You can import 1.x clipboard history during initial setup. Reconfigure settings and pair your devices again in 2.0.
zh: 本次桌面内测增加从 1.6.2-alpha.2 升级所需的 macOS 启动入口和 Windows 安装支持。旧更新源须通过原生验收后才提供升级。可在首次设置时导入 1.x 剪贴板历史。请在 2.0 中重新配置设置并配对设备。
